description: Generates Rust documentation and returns structured output with warning count.

documentPrivateItems.description: Include private items in the generated documentation (--document-private-items)

features.description: Space or comma separated list of features to activate (--features)

frozen.description: Require Cargo.lock and cache are up to date (--frozen)

locked.description: Require Cargo.lock is up to date (--locked)

noDefaultFeatures.description: Do not activate the default feature (--no-default-features)

open.description: Open docs in browser after generating

package.description: Package to document in a workspace (-p <SPEC>)

target.description: Generate docs for the target triple (--target <TRIPLE>)

workspace.description: Generate documentation for all packages in the workspace (--workspace)

name: doc

warningDetails.description: Structured warning details with file, line, and message

title: Cargo Doc
